'''Anna Marciniak-Czochra''' (born 11 March 1974 in [[Lublin]], [[Poland]]) is a Polish [[applied mathematics|applied mathematician]] and [[theoretical biology|mathematical biologist]]. Since 2011 she has been a professor of applied mathematics in the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Sciences at [[Heidelberg University]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Graziotto|first=Johanna|title=Prof. Dr. Anna Marciniak-Czochra - Universität Heidelberg|url=https://www.marsilius-kolleg.uni-heidelberg.de/fellows/marciniak-czochra.html|access-date=2021-05-20|website=www.marsilius-kolleg.uni-heidelberg.de|language=de}}</ref>

She earned her [[Master of Science]] in mathematics 1998 at the [[University of Warsaw]], her [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] (with honors) in Mathematics 2004 at the Heidelberg University.<ref>{{Cite web|title=CV Anna_Marciniak_Czochra|url=http://wwwagmarciniak.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de/folder_people/Anna.Marciniak/documents/CV_Anna_Marciniak_Czochra.pdf|url-status=live|access-date=2021-05-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210520205716/http://wwwagmarciniak.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de/folder_people/Anna.Marciniak/documents/CV_Anna_Marciniak_Czochra.pdf |archive-date=2021-05-20 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Anna Marciniak-Czochra|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=3Epu8YUAAAAJ&hl=en|access-date=2021-05-20|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>

Since 2016 she has been leader of applied analysis and modelling in biosciences at the Heidelberg University.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Anna Marciniak-Czochra Homepage|url=http://wwwagmarciniak.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de/folder_people/Anna.Marciniak/cv.html|access-date=2021-05-20|website=wwwagmarciniak.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de}}</ref>
